• Director 4 (appointed 12 Nov 2024) | | **Auditor** | Audit Firm 8 (unqualified opinions for FY 2022‑2024) | ### Financial Highlights (RM) | FY | Revenue | Gross Profit | Operating Profit | Net Profit | Total Assets | Total Equity | Leverage Ratio* | |----|---------|--------------|------------------|-----------|--------------|--------------|-----------------| | **2022** | 37.58 M | 10.15 M (27.0 % GP) | 3.25 M (8.6 % OP) | 2.23 M (5.9 % NP) | 24.11 M | 10.76 M | 1.24 | | **2023** | 30.35 M | 8.07 M (26.6 % GP) | 1.59 M (5.2 % OP) | 1.01 M (3.3 % NP) | 19.83 M | 11.47 M | 0.73 | | **2024** | 24.21 M | 5.64 M (23.3 % GP) | 0.55 M (2.3 % OP) | 0.27 M (1.1 % NP) | 18.65 M | 11.66 M | 0.60 | \*Leverage Ratio = Total Liabilities ÷ Total Equity ### Trend Summary * **Revenue** has been falling steadily (‑36 % from 2022 to 2024). * **Profitability** is compressing: gross‑profit margin dropped from 27 % to 23 %; net‑profit margin fell from 5.9 % to 1.1 % over the three years. * **Liquidity** remains solid: quick ratio stayed above 1.3 each year, cash‑to‑revenue rose modestly to ~8 % in 2024. * **Cash generation** is positive but declining; free cash flow fell from RM 1.9 M (2022) to RM 0.1 M (2024). * **Capital structure** is improving – leverage fell from 1.24 × to 0.60 ×, and interest‑coverage dropped but stays above 2.7 × in 2024. ### Operational Efficiency * Cash conversion cycle improved from ~101 days (2022) to ~75 days (2024). * Inventory turnover increased (3.83 × → 4.66 ×), indicating better stock management. ### Outlook Kirana Everbright Packaging is a fully‑owned subsidiary of Sejahtera Holdings, operating in the niche of food‑grade plastic packaging. While the balance sheet is healthy and liquidity strong, the company faces a clear revenue and margin contraction trend. Continued focus on cost control, product mix, and possibly expanding into higher‑margin segments will be critical to reverse the profitability decline.
